source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if BP can detect NVMe sucessfully

1. Insert NVMe switch adapter and power on.
2. Boot into BIOS and check NVMe SSD in NVMe switch adapter information correctly.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Can enter into BIOS without any problems.
2. The controller info displays correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Truncated smartctl inventory plus lsblk for NVMe or sd devices.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; read-only OS inventory cannot insert the switch adapter, enter BIOS or prove firmware-screen information, and `head -40` can truncate relevant fields.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds adapter/SSD/slot mapping, safe power procedure, BIOS evidence, OOB recovery and OS correlation.

original_test_intent: Verify that the installed NVMe switch adapter exposes the expected NVMe SSD population through the backplane and that BIOS can be entered and displays correct controller/drive information for those physical identities.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the exact switch adapter under a safe power/ESD procedure, powers on and navigates BIOS to record the expected fields; the agent collects untruncated PCIe/NVMe/OS/controller/BMC inventory and correlates each SSD serial and slot with the BIOS evidence.
manual_activity: Physical switch-adapter installation plus BIOS navigation and visual verification are central acceptance actions. OS inventory is supportive only, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: NVMe switch adapter model/serial/firmware and compatible PCIe slot/power requirements
Backplane port/bay and SSD model/serial/firmware population
BIOS version, menu path and expected adapter/controller/SSD fields
Qualified operator, ESD/powered-off installation steps, KVM and OOB recovery
Validated nvme-cli/PCIe/controller/smartctl inventory methods for the platform
safety_requirements: Install/remove the adapter only in the documented power state with ESD and mechanical controls.
Confirm adapter, power budget, slot lanes/bifurcation and SSD population before power-on.
Do not initialize, format, mount or write any discovered SSD.
Do not infer BIOS success from Linux enumeration or truncate health/identity output.
Stop on wrong hardware, boot failure, PCIe link/power/thermal faults or inconsistent identity; no automatic reseat/reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Validate expected topology and capture pre-install platform evidence.
After operator installation/BIOS capture, collect complete PCIe switch, NVMe namespace/controller, OS and BMC evidence.
Reconcile SSD serial/model/firmware and physical bay across BIOS and OS views.
Report Tool Result and mismatches without claiming BIOS observation or hardware PASS.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically install the NVMe switch adapter and population.
Enter BIOS and visually attest the required controller/SSD fields.
Resolve cross-layer discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only but insufficient: it cannot prove physical installation or BIOS display, mixes NVMe and SCSI devices, and truncates smartctl output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS evidence and use complete `lspci`/NVMe/controller inventory plus smart health only where supported, all mapped by serial and slot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Adapter insertion/power-on, BIOS NVMe information check and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL BIOS VALIDATION WITH COMPLETE TOPOLOGY CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a versioned adapter-to-switch-port-to-bay manifest, timestamped KVM images and full untruncated PCIe/NVMe inventory to prove the same population across layers.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board slot/bifurcation, NVMe switch, backplane and SSD set.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, switch firmware, NVMe firmware, OS kernel/driver and tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform PCIe/NVMe population and BIOS information specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable topology correlation without replacing physical/BIOS work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS visibility can differ from firmware exposure and cannot establish BIOS rendering.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the approved adapter/slot/SSD population. Completion claims must list the exact population and cannot extrapolate to unpopulated backplane bays.
expected_evidence: Adapter/slot/SSD/bay topology, compatibility and safe-install approval
Operator-attributed BIOS entry and adapter/controller/SSD screenshots
Full PCIe/NVMe/controller/OS inventory mapped by serial/model/firmware
BMC/SEL and host logs, discrepancy analysis, Tool Result and separate verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require BIOS access and correct adapter/controller information after installation. The title's `All HDD` scope needs a population manifest but is not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test objective is clear; absent hardware mapping and BIOS expectations are readiness inputs, while the core remains manually executable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects YES and truncated OS evidence as a substitute for adapter installation and BIOS display.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology, safety and correlation safeguards, changing the result to MANUAL ONLY under the locked classification rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes full-population scope and cross-layer identity reconciliation explicit.

review_improvement: Prevents generic OS disk inventory from being reported as proof of BIOS NVMe-switch enumeration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive evidence is a physical adapter population and what BIOS visibly displays. Both require human action/observation; therefore supplemental automation cannot make the case partial or fully automatable.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reseat the adapter, alter BIOS, rescan repeatedly or reboot automatically after an enumeration mismatch. Preserve evidence for the owner.
